title: Wardley Map Canvas
description: Wardley Mapping — components positioned by visibility and evolution. Components require provenance because positioning carries strategic weight.

climatic_predictions.description: Dated, scoreable predictions emitted by the Climate step of /mycelium:wardley-map, v0.95.0+. A map that records positions cannot be wrong; a map that predicts can. Wardley's climatic patterns are the part of the method that generates falsifiable statements, and a map without them is a picture. Each entry names the pattern it came from, what it expects, and WHEN to look — so the next mapping pass scores it instead of re-noticing the same thing as news.

pattern.description: Which climatic pattern generated this. Enumerated so a pass can check coverage — an unused pattern is a pattern nobody applied.

subject.description: Component id, term, or actor the prediction is about.

prediction.description: What is expected to be observably true by `due`. Must be checkable by someone who was not in the room.

due.description: When to look. A prediction with no date is an opinion.

status.description: `unscoreable` is a first-class outcome and must not be avoided: a prediction that turned out not to be checkable is a lesson about the prediction, and recording it as `held` or quietly dropping it is how a forecasting record launders itself clean.

outcome.description: What actually happened, and what it cost to be wrong.
